$comment: Requirement-to-test traceability (TEST_STRATEGY §5). Each test reference names a file and a substring of a test title in it; tests/guards/traceability.test.ts verifies both exist. Status 'partial' means remaining scope belongs to a later work item.

requirements.title: Staff and candidate accounts
requirements.note: Candidate self-registration (M1.2) and invitation-only staff accounts with mandatory MFA (M1.3). Staff permissions are PRD-AUTH-003 (M1.4).

requirements.title: Candidates access only their own information
requirements.note: Own-account security and sessions (M1.2) are enforced by the CANDIDATE_* self-service policies and exact projections (M1.5, ADR-0011); candidate business-record ownership arrives with M2 and the full matrix with M1.7.

requirements.title: Staff permissions are role based
requirements.note: M1.4 delivers the role/permission catalog, scoped effective-dated staff assignments, and the central deny-by-default authorization service (ADR-0005). M1.5 connects it to routes, objects, fields, scoped queries, files, and noninteractive contracts (ADR-0011); real scope adapters arrive in M2 and the exhaustive matrix in M1.7.

requirements.title: Recent authentication for sensitive actions
requirements.note: M1.3 delivers the server-owned recent-authentication primitive (named policies, purpose binding, /staff/reauthenticate) and applies it to staff password change and backup-code regeneration. Business high-risk actions adopt it in their own work items; candidate step-up is not configured. M1.4 composes the primitive into permission-level named recent-auth requirements (purpose-bound, strong methods, no reuse across privilege expansion); route adoption is M1.5.
